topic: Buying a Reduced-Fare Transit Card at the Station

script.title: THE REDUCED-FARE CARD
script.scene_zh: 車站售票亭 · 辦優待卡
script.story_hook: One bus pass, one very happy grandmother.
script.intro_zh: 一張公車月票，換阿嬤一整天的好心情。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the station ticket booth. Listen for fares, proofs, and reload talk.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到車站售票亭。今天留意票價、證明與加值的說法。
script.outro: That's one card bought, one bus caught. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一張卡辦好了，一班公車也趕上了。再聽一次，大聲跟著唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's read each line aloud together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句朗讀跟讀。
script.title_quote: this card is kinder to my knees
script.char_a_description: a plump older woman in her late sixties with steel-grey hair in soft short curls, a lavender quilted jacket over a floral blouse, low-heeled walking shoes, and reading glasses in a breast pocket
script.char_b_description: an easy-going young man in his early thirties with dark hair swept up off his forehead, rectangular black glasses, a magenta transit polo shirt with a station badge, and a medium build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this where I buy a bus pass?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɪz ðɪs wɛr aɪ baɪ ə bʌs pæs/
dialogue.zh: 打擾了，請問是在這裡買巴士票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the place. Regular or reduced fare?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ðə pleɪs ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ɔɹ rɪˈdust fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 就是這裡。要全額票還是優待票？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reduced, um, I heard seniors ride cheaper.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈdʌst ʌm aɪ hɝd ˈsinjɚz raɪd ˈtʃipɚ/
dialogue.zh: 優待票，嗯，聽說長輩搭車比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They do. Do you have proof of age?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈdu du ju hæv pruf əv ˈeɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 是的。您有年齡證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My license, and this library card too?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ænd ðɪs ˈlaɪˌbɛɹi kɑɹd tu/
dialogue.zh: 我的駕照，再加這張借書證可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: License is perfect, the library one is cute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪsəns ɪz ˈpɝfɪkt ðə ˈlaɪˌbɛɹi wʌn ɪz kjuːt/
dialogue.zh: 駕照完全沒問題，借書證那張挺可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that card outlived my student years.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt kɑɹd ˈaʊtˌlɪvd maɪ ˈstuːdənt jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那張卡比我求學的年月還長壽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, a senior card, sixty dollars a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə ˈsinjɚ kɑɹd ˈsɪksɾi ˈdɑɹləz ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，長輩優待卡一個月六十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty, hmm, does that cover rides all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksɾi həm dʌz ðæt ˈkʌvɚ raɪdz ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 六十塊，嗯，那是一整天想怎麼搭就怎麼搭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, unlimited buses all month long.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˌʌnˈlɪməɾɪd ˈbʌsɪz ɔl ˈmʌnθ ˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，整個月巴士無限搭乘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, and the train? I visit my sister.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ænd ðə tɹeɪn aɪ ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈsɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那火車呢？我常去姊姊家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trains count too, half off with this card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɹeɪnz ˈkaʊnt tu hæf ɔf wɪð ðɪs ˈkɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 火車也適用，用這張卡打半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half price, well, my sister lives far.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf praɪs wɛl maɪ ˈsɪstɚ lɪvz fɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 半價啊，嗯，我姊住得遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pays for itself, trust me on that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt peɪz fɚ ɪtˈsɛlf tɹʌst mi ɑn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 省下的車費一下就划算，請相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Now, um, how does this card start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊld naʊ ʌm ˈhaʊ dʌz ðɪs kɑɹd ˈstɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 買了。那麼，嗯，這張卡要怎麼啟用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photo first, look at this little camera.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ fɝst lʊk æt ðɪs ˈlɪɾəl ˈkæməɹə/
dialogue.zh: 先拍照，請看著這個小相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So soon? Oh my, not my best angle.
dialogue.phonetic: /su sʊn oʊ maɪ nɑt maɪ bɛst ˈæŋɡəl/
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？噢，這張角度不好看耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look great, ready for the bus, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk ɡɹeɪt ˈrɛdi fɚ ðə bʌs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 看起來很棒呢，老實說，很有搭車的氣勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, sweet talk won't lower my sixty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ swit tɔk woʊnt ˈloʊɚ maɪ ˈsɪksɾi ˈdɑɹləz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說得再甜，六十塊也不能少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth a try. Now, tap your card here, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɝθ ə ˈtraɪ naʊ ˈtæp jɔɹ kɑɹd hɪɹ ˈpliz/
dialogue.zh: 試試看嘛。好，請在這裡拍一下卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Hmm, it blinked green, is that good?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪk ðɪs həm ɪt ˈblɪŋkt ˈɡrin ɪz ðæt ˈɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣嗎？嗯，它閃綠燈了，是好現象嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great sign, the card is now fully awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt saɪn ðə kɑɹd ɪz naʊ ˈfʊli əˈweɪk/
dialogue.zh: 很好，這張卡現在完全醒來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awake, ha, the newest member of my wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪk hɑ ðə ˈnuɪst ˈmɛmbɚ əv maɪ ˈwɑlɪt/
dialogue.zh: 醒來，哈，它是我錢包最新的成員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, cash or card to start the month?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kæʃ ɔɹ kɑɹd tə ˈstɑɹt ðə ˈmʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，頭一個月用現金還是刷卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, and um, can I add monthly reload?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ænd ʌm kæn aɪ æd ˈmʌnθli ˈɹiːˌloʊd/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，還有，嗯，可以設定每月自動加值嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, five dollars off for auto-debit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn faɪv ˈdɑɹləz ɔf fɚ ˈɔɾoʊ ˈdɛbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，自動扣款每月再折五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No way, five dollars back every month?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈweɪ faɪv ˈdɑɹləz bæk ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧，每個月都退五塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every month, just link your bank details.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri mʌnθ dʒʌst lɪŋk jɔɹ bæŋk dɪˈteɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 每個月都有，只要連上您的帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nephew sets up all my machines.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈnɛfju sɛts ʌp ɔl maɪ məˈʃinz/
dialogue.zh: 這些機器都給我侄子去設定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart nephew. By the way, students save too.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈnɛfju baɪ ðə weɪ ˈstuːdənts seɪv tu/
dialogue.zh: 聰明的侄子。說起來，學生票也有優惠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! My grandson begs for bus money daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ ˈɡɹænsən bɛɡz fɚ bʌs ˈmʌni ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 噢！我孫子天天跟我要公車錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him about our half-price student card.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm əˈbaʊt ɑʊɹ hæf praɪs ˈstuːdənt kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 跟他說說我們的半價學生卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What proof does he need for a student one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt pruf dʌz hi nid fɚ ə ˈstuːdənt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 學生卡需要什麼證明呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: School photo ID, nothing harder than that.
dialogue.phonetic: /skul ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪˈdi ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈhɑɹdɚ ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 學校附照片的學生證，沒比這更難的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He has one, taped together, half chewed up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hæz wʌn teɪpt təˈɡɛðɚ hæf tʃud ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 他有一張，用膠帶黏補過，還缺了一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, as long as the name shows, we accept.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ æz lɔŋ æz ðə neɪm ʃoʊz wi əkˈsɛpt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，只要名字還辨得出來，我們都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now, where do I tap this on board?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt naʊ wɛr du aɪ tæp ðɪs ɑn bɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。上車時，我要在哪裡拍卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right by the driver, black reader machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt baɪ ðə ˈdɹaɪvɚ blæk ˈridɚ məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 就在司機旁邊，一台黑色感應機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if it beeps red, like the mall elevator?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ɪt bipz rɛd laɪk ðə mɔl ˈɛləˌveɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 要是它閃紅燈，像商場電梯那樣，該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then show the driver your card and smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃoʊ ðə ˈdɹaɪvɚ jɔɹ kɑɹd ænd smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 就給司機看一下卡，再送他一個微笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheapest insurance in this whole city.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipɪst ɪnˈʃɚəns ɪn ðɪs hoʊl ˈsɪɾi/
dialogue.zh: 這可是全城最划算的保險了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! One more thing, the reload machines outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ði ˈɹiːˌloʊd məˈʃinz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈！還有件事，外面的加值機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The noisy one that ate my dollar in July?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnɔɪzi wʌn ðæt eɪt maɪ ˈdɑɹlɚ ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是那台很吵、七月時吞我一塊錢的機器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, we're still mad at it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈwʌn wɪɹ ˈstɪl ˈmæd æt ɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 就是那台，我們對它也還沒消氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, should I use it or avoid it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm ʃʊd aɪ juz ɪt ɔɹ əˈvɔɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我，嗯，該用它還是躲著它？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the kiosk inside, it's the polite one.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði ˈkɪɑsk ɪnˈsaɪd ɪts ðə pəˈlaɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 用廳內那台自助機，它比較有禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Polite machine, got it, you people are fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /pəˈlaɪt məˈʃin ɡɑɾ ɪt ju ˈpipəl ɑɹ fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 有禮貌的機器，記下了，你們真有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try. Your first month starts tomorrow, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi traɪ jɔɹ fɝst mʌnθ stɑɹts təˈmɑɹoʊ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們努力嘛。您的頭一個月明天開始，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it let my knees ride free today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt lɛt maɪ ˈniz raɪd fri təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那今天我的膝蓋就能免費坐車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, the clock starts tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ ðə klɑk stɑɹts təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 今天還不行，計時從明天起算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then one regular ride for the old knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn ˈrɛɡjəlɚ raɪd fɚ ði oʊld niz/
dialogue.zh: 那就原價再搭一趟，心疼一下我的老膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or the number six bus stops right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ ðə ˈnʌmbɚ sɪks bʌs stɑps raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 六號公車就在那邊停靠喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six, with the shade tree at the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks wɪð ðə ʃeɪd tri æt ðə ˈkɔɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 六號，就是停在陰涼大樹下站牌的那班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've ridden longer than I've worked here.
dialogue.phonetic: /juv ˈɹɪdən ˈlɔŋɡɚ ðæn aɪv wɝkt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您搭車的時間，比我在這兒上班還久吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, this card is kinder to my knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɪs kɑɹd ɪz ˈkaɪndɚ tə maɪ niz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這張卡對我的膝蓋更體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your knees and your wallet both say thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ ˈniz ænd jɔɹ ˈwɑlɪt boʊθ ˈseɪ ˈθæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 你的膝蓋和錢包，今天都一起說謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, careful, I might cry into this photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑˈhɑ ˈkɛɚfəl aɪ maɪt kraɪ ˈɪntə ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈哈，小心點，我會感動到哭進證件照裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your receipt, and a map for the lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɚz jɔɹ ɹɪˈsit ænd ə mæp fɚ ðə laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 這是收據，再附上一張路線圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bless you, dear boy. Now off to see my sister.
dialogue.phonetic: /blɛs ju dɪɹ bɔɪ naʊ ˈɔf tə si maɪ ˈsɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，好孩子。我現在搭車去姊姊家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ride easy, ma'am, the six bus is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪd ˈizi mæm ðə sɪks bʌs ɪz ˈweɪɾɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢搭，太太，六號公車正等著您呢。

script.youtube_title: 【車站辦優待卡🚌】「這張卡對我的膝蓋更體貼」💳月票・半價・加值機怎麼用🎫｜60句沉浸式英語聽力練習｜Reduced-Fare Transit Card
script.youtube_title_en: "This Card Is Kinder to My Knees" — Buying a Reduced-Fare Transit Card
script.youtube_description:
「這張卡對我的膝蓋更體貼」——阿嬤走進車站售票亭，想辦一張優待交通卡，從年齡證明、拍照啟用，一路問到月票、學生半價與那台吞錢的加值機。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在車站的票務櫃台前。

你會聽到：問明優待資格與證明文件的開場；證件照角度不好時怎麼自我解嘲；六十塊月票到底包不包火車、怎麼設定自動加值；孫子的破學生證能不能辦半價卡；以及在車上遇到紅燈感應、車外遇到脾氣不好的加值機時，又該怎麼反應。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人日常搭車的真實語感：um、well、hmm、yep、no way。聽完你就會用：Do you have proof of age?、half price、Can I add monthly reload?、Tap your card here。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"This card is kinder to my knees" — a grandmother walks into the station booth to buy a reduced-fare transit card, and the conversation goes far: age proof, a surprise photo, monthly passes, student discounts, and a reload machine with a reputation. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a transit ticket booth.

You will hear: asking who qualifies for reduced fare and what proof to bring; laughing at an unflattering card photo; checking whether sixty dollars a month covers buses and trains; setting up auto-reload and the five-dollar discount; and the polite in-house kiosk versus the grumpy machine outside that ate a dollar in July.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk riders actually use: um, well, hmm, yep, no way. By the end you'll own phrases like Do you have proof of age?, Can I add monthly reload?, and Half price.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.
